rules.sentence: When `WS-ACCOUNTS-STATUS` is not `'00'`, it opens `ACCOUNTS-IN` for input and `ACCOUNTS` for output; and stops the run.

When `WS-ACCOUNTS-STATUS` is `'00'`, it opens `ACCOUNTS-IN` for input and `ACCOUNTS` for output; repeats its loop until `WS-AT-END` is `'Y'` (`ACCOUNTS-AT-END`); closes `ACCOUNTS-IN` and `ACCOUNTS`; and stops the run.

conditions: WRITE CARD-ACCOUNT FROM ACCOUNT-LINE INVALID KEY

rules.sentence: When reading `ACCOUNTS-IN` finds no more records, it reads `ACCOUNTS-IN` and sets `WS-AT-END` to `ACCOUNTS-AT-END`.
When reading `ACCOUNTS-IN` finds a record and writing `CARD-ACCOUNT` fails on its key, it reads `ACCOUNTS-IN`, writes `CARD-ACCOUNT` from `ACCOUNT-LINE`, and sets `WS-RESULT` to 8.
When reading `ACCOUNTS-IN` finds a record and writing `CARD-ACCOUNT` succeeds by its key, it reads `ACCOUNTS-IN` and writes `CARD-ACCOUNT` from `ACCOUNT-LINE`.
